saveTemplate.title: Save "{name}" as a template
saveTemplate.hint: The template keeps a copy of the chosen settings. Later changes to this project don't change it. Docs, agents, schedules and webhooks aren't saved.
saveTemplate.allTeamsHint: Turn off to choose the teams that see this template when they create a project.
saveTemplate.previewEmpty: Choose a project to see what the template will hold.
saveTemplate.importHint: Paste a template copied from another workspace, or upload its file. The people it named are left out.
saveTemplate.importEmpty: Paste a template to see what it holds.
saveTemplate.importInvalid: This is not a project template, or it is damaged.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes {name} and everything in it: issues, comments, attachments, and settings. This cannot be undone.

leaveDialog.title: Leave {name}?
leaveDialog.description: You will lose access to {name} and its work items. To join again you need a new invite from an owner.

editDialog.title: Edit project
editDialog.keyHint: Issue links need a key of capital letters and digits that starts with a letter. After you save it, the key cannot change.
